assessment: The isolated 20 Td extension passes every unchanged gate. Relative standard error decreases from 3.54% to 1.55%, half-window change decreases from 6.22% to 1.11%, and the drift remains stable relative to the parent estimate while differing from the ETHZ consensus by only +2.98%. Together with the unchanged passing 10 and 30 Td parent points, all modern three-field gates are complete.
scientific_significance: AuroraPIC with the fixed Phelps-based argon package is consistent with the modern ETHZ pressure-resolved pulsed-Townsend mobility benchmark across 10-30 Td under prospectively declared uncertainty-aware criteria. This extends prior historical 52.8-99.7 Td evidence into the Ramsauer-region low-field regime and removes historical coefficient-convention ambiguity for this conservative-collision range.
claim_boundary: The extension is not an independent-seed replication and the Phelps package may be swarm-informed. The LXCat rows do not provide pointwise measurement uncertainty or temperature; cross-pressure sample scatter is used conservatively. Homogeneous transport evidence does not validate self-consistent fields, ions, boundaries, imported geometry, chemistry, collective behavior, or device observables.
